lines.text: At midnight the LORD struck down every firstborn male in Egypt, and there was loud wailing because every house had someone dead.
Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron by night and told them to leave and take their flocks and herds.
The people took their dough before it was leavened and carried it on their shoulders in kneading bowls wrapped in clothing.
The Israelites journeyed from Rameses to Bethel with about 600,000 men on foot, besides women and children.
The Israelites stayed in Egypt 400 years, and on the very day those years ended, all the LORD's divisions went out.
